mark_affecting.quote: Priestley writes these devastatingly simple stage directions: Eric enters, looking extremely pale and distressed. They stare at him. He comes in, the door slowly closes behind him. Curtain.
Honestly, that slow-closing door is so incredibly symbolic.
It literally seals the family's fate.
Eric enters, looking extremely pale and distressed... the door slowly closes behind him, curtain.
